fields.education: His first-person [account of entering AI](https://www.interconnects.ai/p/my-path-into-ai) describes Berkeley doctoral research from 2017 to early 2022; I do not infer a Cornell degree from a reference to earlier rowing there.
fields.career: The farewell describes work on Olmo models and reflects on the impact of open research despite performance limits. His [first-person career account](https://www.interconnects.ai/p/my-path-into-ai) documents the earlier doctoral and industry path.
fields.outlook: Lambert's June 2026 Ai2 farewell makes the next released post-training recipe, rather than an outdated affiliation, the work to follow. A label of open is weaker than a usable recipe. The next meaningful result would reduce the gap between reading a report and being able to train and assess a comparable model.
fields.read: Interconnects / open post-training's challenge is to avoid an open label applied to artifacts that leave the important training choices inaccessible.

fields.outlook: Patel's long-form interviews leave a record of disagreements and predictions that readers can compare with later events. I would track a guest’s specific prediction against its stated deadline, rather than score an interview by prominence alone.
fields.read: Patel would lose my confidence over a persuasive interview becoming a substitute for independently checked evidence.

I would run the examples, inspect the evaluation setup and distinguish a teaching simplification from an implementation error.
